self_report.trigger_items: Being looked at sexually,Being alone with men,Hearing related names
self_report.appraisals_items_original: I have to be on guard all the time | The world is a dangerous place | There is something about me that made the event happen
self_report.memory_items_original: My memories of the frightening event are mostly pictures or images. | I remember the frightening event as a few moments, and each moment is a picture in my mind. | When memories come to mind of what happened, I feel my body is in the same position as when the frightening event occurred.
self_report.threat_items_original: Having strong negative feelings such as fear, horror, anger, guilt, or shame? | Being “superalert” or watchful or on guard? | Feeling jumpy or easily startled?
self_report.strategies_items_original: ruminate about how event could have been prevented | vigilant for dangerous people | make sure to stay close to exit
self_report.avoidance_items_original: Being reminded of the event by others | Sex | Situations in which other people evaluate me / my appearance / my performance
